in_marathi.name: Shilpa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shilpa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word शिल्प (shilpa) meaning 'carving', 'sculpture', or 'craft'. In Hindu mythology, Shilpa is a name for the goddess of arts and crafts, Patron of artists and architects. This name is associated with creativity, beauty, and skill.
